routing_changes.change: Removed owner_only and required_permission from the Organizations navigation item.
Marks admin.organizations as an authenticated-user organization list entry in the frontend capability graph.

create_visibility_enforcement.rule: CreateOrganizationSection is rendered only when useAuth().isOwner is true.

list_visibility_enforcement.rule: OrganizationListSection is rendered for every authenticated route visitor.

backend_alignment_note: Existing backend endpoints were reused. Current backend GET /organizations and GET /users are not modified by this refactor; if an existing backend role gate denies a non-owner request, the frontend shows a safe error state instead of crashing.
